name: Maureen Coomer
story: Maureen Coomer is named in GNS Science’s metadata for the 1:1 million Geological Map of New Zealand as one of the contributors to digital capture, alongside Aleksandra Lukovic, Belinda Smith Lyttle and Delia Strong. The credit documents a specific part of national geological map production. It should not be read as identifying the people who digitised the earlier QMAP sheets, whose production history requires separate evidence.
